reason: I already have a LARQ that I carry to the gym every day and it works fine. Paying almost $68 today plus signing up for a filter subscription just to swap one bottle for another isn't worth it to me.
objection: I already have a bottle that works, and I don't want another subscription for filters from a brand I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: If my current bottle broke and a creator I trust showed a real side-by-side test proving Claro filters better than what I have, at around $35 for the bottle with no subscription required.
